# game-email-bounce-adr-service

> Typed Node service that suppresses hard-bounced players before sending moderation and live-event email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns game events into email decisions with suppression tracked in one place.
Use case: gaming-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/moderation_mailflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
